properties.name: Somoskő
properties.sourcePeriod: June 2022 ITS 2021–2027; subdivision inherited from 2008 IVS / 2014 ITS; native cadastral-map date unknown
properties.method: Original embedded municipal profile-image color-component pixel-cell outer contours. All original components and every external pixel edge retained; only tiny fully enclosed cadastral/JPEG mask voids are interpreted as cartographic ink and filled. Native raw masks and outer outlines both archived. Similarity matching to actual corresponding overview color contours, then an unvalidated inferred overview-to-EOV affine fit against current municipality silhouette, then EPSG:4326. No source-name point controls, buffer, hull, chord, snapping, repair, image-frame closure or clipping. Registration residuals are internal diagnostics and do not establish absolute accuracy.
properties.registrationUncertainty: The overview silhouette fit and profile/overview contour correspondence are approximate. Original raster CRS, physical controls, independent holdouts and absolute accuracy are unestablished. Forgáchtelep northwest profile/overview contours differ; Zagyvaróna and Somlyóbánya also retain local contour residuals. No mismatch is repaired or hidden.

properties.attribution: Salgótarján MJV Integrált Településfejlesztési Stratégiája 2021–2027, June2022, pp125–137; © OpenStreetMap contributors for modern reference data.
